## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 276 captures during June 2021. Activity was completed through the scheduled clinic sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that imaging proceeded without any reported disruption beyond this routine staffing arrangement.

The capture total provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. It should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the subsequent grading results.

## Image quality

A total of 14 captures were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.1 of all captures. These records could not be used for grading and should remain subject to the usual quality review process. The result provides an indication of the proportion of imaging requiring attention, while the remaining captures progressed to grading.

## Grading

There were 54 referable results during June 2021. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that the central grading process generally returned results promptly during the reporting period. The referable result count should be reviewed with the image-quality findings to support ongoing monitoring of clinic performance and follow-up arrangements.
